name: Akhil
reason: Common name; akhila = whole, entire. Correct.

name: Ambuj
reason: ambu + ja, water-born, the lotus. Correct.

name: Ankit
reason: aṅkita, marked, distinguished. Correct.

name: Ankur
reason: aṅkura, sprout. Correct.

name: Anmol
reason: IAST does not match the name as written; Hindi anmol (an- + mol, price), not Sanskrit.

name: Arpit
reason: arpita, offered, dedicated. Correct.

name: Bhanupratap
reason: bhānu + pratāpa, splendour of the sun. Established name.

name: Chandraprakash
reason: candra + prakāśa, light of the moon. Established name.

name: Deependra
reason: dīpa + indra, lord of light. Common modern name.

name: Dhruvesh
reason: Meaning acceptable but the name is a modern compound; mark as coinage.

fix.name: Dhruvesh
fix.meaning_en: Lord of the pole star; steadfast lord (modern coinage).

name: Divyanshu
reason: divya + aṃśu, divine ray. Correct.

name: Garvit
reason: garvita, proud, dignified. Common modern name.

name: Gyanendra
reason: jñāna + indra, lord of knowledge. Correct.

name: Kartavya
reason: kartavya, duty. Used as a modern boy name.

name: Kuldeep
reason: IAST should follow the name as written and pronounced (kuldīp).

name: Lavesh
reason: Modern coinage, already noted honestly.

name: Manas
reason: मानस: of the mind, heart; the sacred lake Mānasa. Acceptable.

name: Mridul
reason: mṛdula, soft, gentle. Correct.

name: Nikunj
reason: nikuñja, bower, grove, associated with Krishna. Correct.

name: Paras
reason: pārasa, the philosopher's stone. Common name.

name: Pranjal
reason: prāñjala, straightforward, sincere. Correct.

name: Ruchir
reason: rucira, beautiful, radiant. Correct.

name: Sanchit
reason: sañcita, collected, accumulated. Common name.

name: Saransh
reason: sāra + aṃśa, essence. Common modern name.

name: Shivam
reason: śivam, auspicious, the good. Correct.

name: Sparsh
reason: sparśa, touch. Used as a modern boy name.

name: Subodh
reason: su + bodha, well understood, wise. Correct.

name: Suyash
reason: IAST shows the stem suyaśas, not the name as written.

name: Tanuj
reason: tanu + ja, son. Correct.

name: Utsav
reason: utsava, festival. Correct.

name: Vardhan
reason: vardhana, growth, one who increases. Correct.

name: Vatsal
reason: vatsala, affectionate. Correct.

name: Vibhor
reason: Hindi word; claimed Sanskrit source vibhora is not attested. Mark etymology honestly.

fix.name: Vibhor
fix.meaning_en: Engrossed, overwhelmed with joy (Hindi; Sanskrit etymology uncertain).
